description: Use this when the signed-in owner gives a lasting correction for all their future posts, like 'less pink', 'more premium' or 'never use emojis'. It's saved with their brand and applies to every post from now on (Suara keeps the 8 most recent notes). For a change to one post, use request_post_change.
